title: CoverageSummary
description: A model-wide test summary report record that totals the coverage targets, coverage requirements and test case sketches of exactly one TestCoverageModel at a point in time. Per-target figures are rolled up from the model's TargetCoverageSummary records. Use TargetCoverageSummary instead when the metrics (sketch, implemented and automated counts or a percentage) describe a single TestCoverageTarget rather than the whole model. Use CoverageGap instead when the artifact records one specific shortfall between required and achieved coverage, with a severity and a remediation status, rather than aggregate totals. Use TestCoverageModel instead when the artifact is the coverage specification itself, holding the targets, partitions and requirements, rather than a generated report about it. Use CoverageExclusion instead when the artifact is an approved decision to leave a target or requirement uncovered, rather than a count of what is covered.

modelRef.description: ID of the testing.testcoveragemodel this summary aggregates

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time at which the summary was computed; set it every time the summary is regenerated so stale reports can be detected.

totalTargets.description: Non-negative count of TestCoverageTarget nodes in the referenced model at generation time, including targets that have exclusions or gaps.

totalRequirements.description: Non-negative count of CoverageRequirement nodes across all targets in the referenced model at generation time.

totalSketches.description: Non-negative count of TestCaseSketch nodes across all targets in the model regardless of status; this equals the sum of sketchCount over the model's TargetCoverageSummary records.

x-dr-standard: IEEE 829-2008 Clause 17 Master Test Report / Clause 16 Level Test Report (overview and summary of results; the Test Summary Report in IEEE 829-1998)
x-dr-evidence: A script or CI job that loads the test coverage model (YAML or JSON) and emits totals of targets, requirements and test cases with a generation timestamp.
A generated report artifact (e.g. coverage-model-summary.json or a Markdown table in docs/testing) that lists overall counts per model and links to per-target summaries.
A test-reporting dashboard or README section that publishes model-level totals of covered features, requirements and designed test cases for a named application.
